policy: All assessment references use Microsoft Learn. This project defines the control assertions; they do not constitute Microsoft certification.

activeImage.note: Resolved from the official MCR manifest. Python runtime is required by the official Azure CLI RPM. Digest pinning does not establish vulnerability absence.

sources.title: AKS operator and developer best practices
sources.scope: Cloud AKS; distinguishes Automatic and Standard responsibilities.

sources.title: Architecture best practices for AKS
sources.scope: Cloud AKS recommendations for reliability, security, costs, operations and performance.

sources.title: Cluster security and upgrades
sources.scope: API access, container isolation, metadata exposure and upgrades.

sources.title: Pod security best practices
sources.scope: Least privilege, Linux security contexts, workload identity and vaults.

sources.title: Network connectivity and security best practices
sources.scope: Address planning, ingress, network policies, DNS and node access.

sources.title: Deployment and cluster reliability best practices
sources.scope: Replicas, probes, disruption budgets, topology and system node pools.

sources.title: Application resource management best practices
sources.scope: CPU and memory requests and limits; measured sizing.

sources.title: Basic scheduler best practices
sources.scope: Namespace quotas and disruption budgets.

sources.title: Storage and backup best practices
sources.scope: Storage choice, dynamic provisioning, retention and backup integrity.

sources.title: Monitor AKS
sources.scope: Metrics, Container insights, control-plane resource logs and alerts.

sources.title: Secure AKS with Azure Policy
sources.scope: Add-on enablement is distinct from policy assignments and compliance.

sources.title: AKS baseline architecture for Azure Local
sources.scope: Local control plane, physical hosts, storage, security and capacity. Cloud-only recommendations are not automatically applied to Local.

sources.title: Security book for Arc-enabled Kubernetes and AKS enabled by Arc
sources.scope: Platform, workload, operations, data and network security for edge clusters.

sources.title: Provisioned cluster instance resource reference
sources.scope: Local controlPlane.count and controlPlane.controlPlaneEndpoint.hostIP. Describes API fields, not configuration recommendations.

sources.title: Azure CLI aksarc reference
sources.scope: Read-only Local metadata collection; preinstall the aksarc extension.

sources.title: Run Azure CLI in a Docker container
sources.scope: Official Microsoft Container Registry image used only in isolated active tests.

sources.title: Create and manage Azure Disk persistent volumes
sources.scope: WaitForFirstConsumer and topology-aware Azure Disk provisioning.

sources.title: Container image management and security best practices
sources.scope: Validated images, vulnerability assessment and base-image update pipelines. A tag check alone cannot prove these controls.

sources.title: Azure penetration testing policy
sources.scope: Resource-owner authorization and applicable Microsoft rules of engagement. The CLI does not perform DoS, unauthorized access or exploitation.

sources.title: Azure Load Testing overview
sources.scope: Workload-specific performance tests with separate approval. The CLI's HTTP latency and error budgets are operator-defined, not Microsoft performance requirements.

sources.title: Azure CLI interactive and device-code authentication
sources.scope: Explicit tenant-scoped device authentication. Conditional Access can disallow this flow; never bypass it.

sources.title: Azure RBAC best practices
sources.scope: Least privilege, narrow scopes and privileged access review; assignment metadata alone does not establish effective authorization.

sources.title: Defender for Containers overview
sources.scope: Subscription plan and scoped assessment metadata; telemetry freshness and runtime detection remain independent evidence.

sources.title: Azure Advisor overview
sources.scope: Existing scoped cost, reliability, performance, security and operational recommendations; no automatic refresh or remediation.

sources.title: Pod Security Admission in AKS
sources.scope: Namespace enforcement labels, policy versions and exceptions; labels are distinct from tested enforcement.

sources.title: Azure Container Registry security baseline
sources.scope: Managed authentication, network access and registry administrator configuration.

sources.title: Azure Key Vault security overview
sources.scope: RBAC, soft delete, purge protection and vault network metadata, without reading stored values.

sources.title: Security recommendations for Blob storage
sources.scope: Secure transfer, minimum TLS, anonymous access and identity-based authorization; no data-plane collection.

sources.title: Azure network security groups overview
sources.scope: Declared rules and subnet association; effective traffic decisions require attachment, priority, route and firewall context.
